title: Stage and qualify a package
summary: Create a clean staging tree, inspect all packaging breaches together, discover tests and their environment references, update changelog, then seal only when READY.
procedure: Create stage from source; generated caches, VCS metadata and prior root ZIPs are excluded.
Run package.stage.check and review all breaches together.
Ensure CHANGELOG contains the candidate version.
Ensure at least one discoverable test exists and review its environment references.
Run qualification tests and record evidence.
Only seal/package after the stage reports READY.
invariants: Package membership is declared/staged, not inferred from filesystem proximity.
Dependencies are external by default; embedding requires explicit package policy.
Do not seal a package with BLOCKER packaging breaches.
